subtitle: Out Cebu · China Eastern Airlines
overview: Fly Cebu to Shanghai on China Eastern Airlines, see Nanjing Road and the Bund, then fly on to Zhangjiajie. Explore the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) with Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge and Golden Whip Stream, staying in 5★ hotels. Return to Shanghai for Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Tourist Mart and Florentia Village outlets before flying home.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 27–Dec 1 2026 to Dec 11–15 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known shopping street, lined with stores, restaurants and neon signs.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar: A park of towering sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains of the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face to the scenic area.
placeDesc.Tianzishan Cable Car: A cable car taking guests up to the Tianzi Mountain viewpoints, as an alternative to the lift.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone arch bridge linking two cliffs, the first stop at the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar peak that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Breath-taking Platform: A viewing platform at the Avatar scenic area with sweeping views of the rock pillars.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint known for sea-of-clouds views over the pillar forest.
placeDesc.Seventy-two Odd Buildings: A hot-spot viewpoint where rock formations look like rows of tall buildings.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-floored suspension bridge spanning a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic valley stream walk beneath tall rock walls in Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Xibu Folk Culture Street: A large walking street in Zhangjiajie with local food, crafts and folk culture.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum showing paintings made from local Zhangjiajie sandstone.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A traditional Shanghai temple area beside the old city bazaar, visited with Yuyuan Tourist Mart.
placeDesc.Yuyuan Tourist Mart: A traditional-style bazaar in old Shanghai for souvenirs, snacks and local products.
placeDesc.Florentia Village Shanghai: An outlet shopping village in Shanghai with free time for shopping.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain (optional): Optional tour with cable car, glass skywalk and Tianmen Cave, USD 85 per person.
placeDesc.Baofeng Lake (optional): Optional tour of a mountain lake with a cruise, USD 60 per person.
